description: List the models ChinaAPI serves, optionally filtered by capability, task, maker or a model-ID substring. Each entry has the exact model ID, maker, capabilities and tasks, context window, headline Standard prices (and Paid prices where they are lower) and the model's ChinaAPI page. Sorted by maker, then model ID; page with cursor. Use chinaapi_get_model for one model's endpoints, full prices and limits.

capability.description: Capability direction: text-multimodal (chat, reasoning, coding, vision), image, video, audio-speech or decision.

maker.description: Maker name exactly as returned in maker (case-insensitive), e.g. DeepSeek.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the model ID.

task.description: A task within a capability, e.g. image-to-video or transcription. Must belong to capability when both are given.

name: chinaapi_list_models
title: List ChinaAPI models
